chromadb.reason: These advisories affect Chroma's HTTP server, configurable remote-code embedding functions, and multi-tenant SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider. The supported stack uses only PersistentClient in the RAG process, no Chroma HTTP listener or SimpleRBAC provider, a fixed checksummed MiniLM ONNX model, and no caller-supplied embedding configuration. The only network interface is the authenticated RAG API. Do not re-enable the Chroma HTTP server without resolving these advisories.
